First release of keyburn.

keyburn spots a stolen OpenAI or Anthropic API key from the provider's own usage data. It reads the official Admin APIs, works out how much each key used per day, and raises an alert when:

- a key's use today or yesterday is more than N times its own median day over the last two weeks
- a key you marked as dormant shows any use at all
- your spend so far today is above a limit you set

It is one static binary meant to run from cron. Alerts go to stdout, and optionally to ntfy, a webhook or email through the local `sendmail`. Each alert is sent once.

keyburn only reads. It never creates, changes or revokes keys, and it never prints or logs the admin keys you give it.

Binaries below are static builds for Linux and macOS (amd64 and arm64). Check them against checksums.txt.
